slot_note: Numbered against seed RC07 (a supplier's January imbalance bill and plant trips). The seed's world could not carry an honest unbanned draw, architecture 1 (a frailty virtual ward against care home closures, Epidemiology and Public Health) died at stage 2 on published admission rates, and architecture 2 (a canola hybrid against July heat in late-seeded fields' flowering windows, Economics and Econometrics) died at stage 2 when the golden method's own variants straddled the bar and flexible controls on seeding dates landed the golden. Architecture 3 re-roots in Marketing and Consumer Research: a GB domestic energy supplier's six-month new-customer satisfaction tracker.
niche: a GB domestic energy supplier's six-month new-customer satisfaction tracker, whose share of satisfied respondents fell between the first halves of 2025 and 2026 while every 2026 respondent was billed on a new billing platform, tariffs rose in October and the contact centre moved to an outsourcer, and whose cause the executive team needs named before the platform's second phase cuts over
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every rating, quote and meter record correctly runs the field's key driver analysis on the tracker (overall satisfaction on the attribute ratings, Shapley shares), links the respondents to their accounts and payments, and books about 6 of the 8.7 points to the new billing platform, because billing accuracy and bill clarity fell furthest and every H1 2026 respondent is billed on it.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each driver's contribution to the fall in the share of satisfied new customers, estimated by a satisfaction driver model that carries each customer's disconfirmation (the cost of the use their meter recorded against the cost they were quoted at the switch), as the expectation-disconfirmation paradigm and the ACSI's expectations construct require; with hospital or school nouns there is no quote at a switch, no metered use to set against it and no six-month satisfaction tracker of switchers.
layer1: the tracker vendor's export changed layout in January 2026 (renamed columns, the overall question moved, a 0 to 10 scale exported as text with its labels)
quotes keyed by quote reference and meter point numbers (MPAN, MPRN) while the tracker and billing key by account number, with accounts re-numbered on migration
meter reads flagged actual, customer or estimated, with register rollovers, meter exchanges and two-rate (Economy 7) registers
the legacy platform stamps reads and bills in UK local time and the new platform in UTC across the clock changes
bill and Direct Debit amounts in pence on the legacy export and pounds on the new, with accounts held on both platforms during the parallel run
stakeholder_role: the supplier's head of customer insight

spine.file: meter reads of the tracker's respondents, July 2024 to June 2026
spine.entity: one meter read on one register

world.geography: Great Britain (an invented domestic energy supplier)

driver: A fall in a share of satisfied members is booked to the service the members' own ratings blame, because those ratings fell furthest and every later member was served by that service, but what moved is the gap between the amount each member was told to expect when they joined and the amount their own later use then cost, which no column holds and only the joining record set against the member's own measured use reveals; members told accurately are as satisfied as before on the same service.
driver_concrete: Six-month satisfaction among the supplier's new customers fell from about 76 to 67 per cent between H1 2025 and H1 2026, and key driver analysis books it to billing accuracy and so to the billing platform every H1 2026 respondent was billed on; but from May 2025 the quote journey stopped pre-filling each meter point's industry annual quantity (EAC, AQ), so customers were quoted on use they typed in or on Ofgem's medium typical values, and those whose meter point's quantity cost more than their quote carry most of the fall, while customers whose quote covered it were as satisfied on the new platform as H1 2025's were on the old.
stump: A competent solver runs key driver analysis on the six-month tracker, sees billing accuracy and bill clarity carry about two thirds of the 8.7-point fall, finds every H1 2026 respondent billed on the new platform, and books about 6 points to the billing platform, holding phase 2, because they never set the annual cost each customer was quoted at the switch against the cost of the annual quantity their meter point then showed, which puts most of the fall on the May 2025 quote journey's quotes and leaves the platform about a point at most.

differentiation.task121: task121 v4 read a satisfaction fall on the operating conditions each journey ran under, because ratings of every candidate rise and fall with the respondent's overall verdict; here the operating record is the default's own rung (bills and Direct Debit reviews), and what decides is the expectation each customer was given at the switch, the quote's assumed use set against the use the meter then recorded, a sales record no conditions file carries.
differentiation.task181: task181 v6 traces each case through two time-ordered records to the shared upstream resource that handled it (a steriliser with a drying fault) and takes that resource's excess off the units it served; here no resource handled the customers differently and nothing is traced to one: the service the ratings blame billed every 2026 respondent alike, and the excess lies in what each customer was told to expect at the switch against what their own metered use then cost.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Epidemiology and Public Health: a community trust's frailty virtual ward in an integrated care system's Core20 neighbourhoods, its pilot-year prevented admissions against care home closures)
lineage.driver: An intervention in one group is credited with a fall in that group's rate against the others', but between the baseline and evaluation periods the group's pool lost a block of its highest-rate members when the places that held them closed, so the baseline rate overstates what the smaller pool would have had; standardised to the evaluation period's mix on that property, which no column of the outcome or population files carries and a capacity record shows, the intervention's effect is a fraction of the difference in differences.
lineage.fate: spent at stage 2 on 2026-11-03 before any data was cut: with care home and community emergency admission rates set to published levels (about 0.70 against 0.24 to 0.58 a resident-year, a same-age ratio near two, not five), the composition lever fell to about 113 admissions for the 440 residents the closures moved, against a draw-to-draw spread of 157 to 215 in the default and the golden; a fixed bar between them separated them in 22 to 27 per cent of draws, and 72 per cent only at 1,400 residents moved, a failure no honest care group closure produces in one system's Core20 neighbourhoods.

lineage.architecture: v2 (Economics and Econometrics: a Saskatchewan farmland operator's canola yield panel, a new hybrid blamed for a 2026 shortfall that July heat in late-seeded fields' flowering windows caused)

world.geography: Canada, west-central Saskatchewan (invented farms in the Dark Brown and Black soil zones)

lineage.driver: A candidate change is blamed for a loss because its units lost more in the season it arrived, but the loss came from a short dated shock that harms a unit only inside a sensitive phase whose timing a clock sets from the unit's own start date at the pace of local conditions; the candidate's units started late for a one-off reason, so their sensitive phases met the shock, and read at equal timing the candidate costs nothing, while every season-wide, unit-level or linear start-date control leaves most of the loss on the candidate.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 2: the golden method's defensible variants straddle the bar, and flexible controls on a variable the default path already builds land the golden (flowering-window variants +2.1, -2.5, -12.0, +3.4, -8.2 and +4.9 per cent against a 5 per cent bar; seeding-week bins +3.6, a cubic +4.4 and same-day matching +9.3 on seeding dates the default's own rung 4 rebuilds, only a linear term still -10.1 or -8.3)

notes: Strategy decomposition_attribution (F8): the fall is a correctly reported movement booked by the ratings to the billing platform; the decisive move books it to the quote journey's typical-use default through each customer's disconfirmation. Layer 2 family field_method: the satisfaction driver model done right carries expectations.
